scope: Deterministic test-local SDK/session/Gateway proof; no live model, production compact@1, process A2A or final release claim.
adapter: Public BeforeModel request projection; SessionService.Get supplies current session because callback Session() is unsupported. Explicit outer-owner checkpoint/continuation; no Scheduler state changes.

commands.note: Full Planner packages with required real PostgreSQL cases. Final test-only policy/framing/retention refinements are covered by the later full changed-package suite.
Final frozen changed-package sources, including closed-union null/missing-discriminator regressions.

commands.boundary: Actual PostgreSQL; integration suite uses its fake WorkerInvoker, not a real Runtime process.

database: Agent-owned disposable PostgreSQL17 database, canonical TMPDIR; all required Planner/store cases executed without skip.
registry_boundary: Values and stable codes are frozen in design evidence. V420-002 installs owning numbered specifications/registries together with enforcement; no planned feature is described as shipped.
accounting: Received rejected responses retain known usage. Missing usage fails as existing planner_gateway_invalid_response and charges the admitted call without inventing tokens.
historical_finding: Finish-before-required-append-error was already fixed by V419-006; existing ordinary/final/PostgreSQL/cancellation regressions ran in full Planner suites.

accepted_assumptions.token_bound: Full serialized UTF-8 request byte count bounds non-overlapping byte-preserving text tokenization; add bounded framing (1024, or1024+128/message above8messages) and output reserve. Unknown expansion/framing routes require an exact supported tokenizer or fail before transport. Operator route/token capacity metadata remains trusted.
accepted_assumptions.peak: Accounted serialized/backing data and structural reserves, not a Go heap/RSS promise. Shared backing counts once; every actual copy counts separately.
accepted_assumptions.oversized_group: Exact UTF-8 document fragments for archive retrieval; active prompt groups never split. A required tail/input that exceeds its containing ceiling fails without truncation.

reversal_condition: SDK, route/tokenizer/framing, source grouping, callback/append timing or ledger-envelope changes require reevaluation before production.

frozen_source_lint.note: Full mandatory gate after all test-code changes; no production/dependency changes.
